subject.title: [Feature]: Stop Burying Your Agent's Soul: Configurable Context File Elevation

question: Should special bootstrap file elevation/exclusion become a core typed config surface, or should OpenClaw solve it through a documented plugin/context-engine prompt contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice affects prompt authority, config surface area, plugin boundaries, prompt-cache stability, and the VISION.md preference for lean core plus plugin-owned optional capability.

options.title: Extend plugin/context-engine contract
options.body: Document or add the minimal hook needed for plugins or context engines to place selected bootstrap content in higher-priority prompt sections and suppress duplicate Project Context rendering.

options.title: Add narrow core config
options.body: Add a typed core pattern-to-section/exclusion setting with schema, docs, tests, and upgrade-safe defaults for the named bootstrap files.

options.title: Keep flat Project Context
options.body: Leave the current renderer unchanged and document supported plugin or hook workarounds instead of adding a new prompt/config surface.

recommendation.title: Extend plugin/context-engine contract
recommendation.body: Document or add the minimal hook needed for plugins or context engines to place selected bootstrap content in higher-priority prompt sections and suppress duplicate Project Context rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal across prompt rendering, config schema, docs, and the prior product/API review for this surface.
